---
title: "POCUS for Critical Care Fellows"
subtitle: "A structured curriculum for bedside echocardiography."
---

## Welcome

This curriculum is built for critical care fellows learning point-of-care
echocardiography. Nine modules, organized around the clinical questions
you'll actually ask at the bedside.

## How to use this site

Work through the modules in order. Each module has the same five parts:

1. **Clinical question** — what bedside decision this exam answers
2. **Image acquisition** — probe, windows, and technique
3. **Normal & normal variants** — the baseline you need before pathology
4. **Pathology library** — organized by finding, not by diagnosis
5. **Integration cases** — where the finding changes management

Each module also has a linked Anki deck for spaced-repetition review and
a quiz to check your understanding.

## Logbook & assessment

[**POCUS Competency Registry**](competency-dashboard.html) — faculty tool for tracking each fellow's competency levels, proctored scan counts, and program milestones across the five core critical care ultrasound domains (per the 2009 ACCP/SRLF consensus, the LUCC Delphi statement, and ACGME 2024 requirements).
